comments.author: hsliuustc0106
comments.body:
I compared frozen head `80936f7` with an independent LTX-2.5 implementation built from the same target base and with the official Diffusers implementation. This PR should be the implementation base: it includes the LTX-2.5-specific CRF-18 I2V path, unpacked FP32 latent RNG/state, FP32 RoPE, static prompt AdaLN tables, cross-modality timestep semantics, the one-token cuDNN fallback, online pipeline-class resolution, and `transformer_full/` support. Those are material correctness/coverage improvements, not just refactoring.

Before merge:

- Tighten `requirements/common.txt` from `transformers >= 5.5.3` to `transformers >= 5.10.1, < 5.15`. The LTX-2.5 profile requires `Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration`; 5.8/5.9 do not provide it, 5.10.0 is yanked, and 5.15 has the known Gemma4 construction regression. The ImportError in `ltx2_components.py` should recommend the same range instead of `>=5.8,<5.15`.
- The CPU-safe affected suite currently reports `262 passed, 4 failed`. All four failures are the existing CFG-parallel cases in `test_ltx2_parallel.py`: the new FP32 paths directly access `self.model_version` on legacy test doubles. Using `getattr(self, "model_version", "2")` in the runtime dtype selection preserves the legacy contract and makes the suite green.
- Add LTX-2.5 to `docs/user_guide/diffusion_features.md`; the table and interpolation note still stop at LTX-2/2.3.
- Add or wire an online e2e test. The checked-in [B300 validation](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/blob/80936f7f782e473def438f56cf2cab54f4e822df/recipes/LTX/LTX-2.5.md#L205-L251) is useful, but no model/GPU test check is visible in CI and there is no attached Diffusers quality-parity artifact.

A few useful choices from the alternative implementation are worth retaining:

- Use `AutoModelForImageTextToText` or otherwise keep version detection tolerant of Gemma4/transformer-signature conversions.
- State explicitly that the supported checkpoint is `Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers`; the raw `Lightricks/LTX-2.5` split-artifact repository is not directly loadable by this path.
- Decide explicitly whether request-provided `sigmas=` should remain supported. This PR rejects custom distilled schedules, while the official Diffusers API accepts them.
- For I2V, CRF-18 should remain the correct default; an explicit `image_crf=0` opt-out would be more flexible than categorically rejecting tensor inputs.

Recommendation: keep this PR's transformer/runtime/full-pipeline implementation, apply the dependency and test fixes above, and carry over only the focused loader/detection/API clarifications rather than combining both patches wholesale.

comments.author: mglyn
comments.body: One accuracy concern: in our previous LTX-2/2.3 work, we found clear numerical differences between the Diffusers and Lightricks official implementations. Since the LTX-2.5 accuracy results here use Diffusers as the reference, they demonstrate Diffusers parity rather than parity with the official pipeline.

comments.author: lishunyang12
comments.body:
## Official LTX-2.5 BF16 cuDNN parity and runnable pipelines

Updated at `8ce11ef77`. The comparison pins native Lightricks source [`7954dcb`](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2/commit/7954dcb0d986bdc36ef272564a9789ade07fcc65), raw model revision `8a4ff96`, connector revision `a6de4b5`, seed 42, identical schedules and conditioning, and explicit BF16 cuDNN attention in both runtimes. MATH is used only for the degenerate one-token fallback.

| vLLM-Omni pipeline | Native reference | Task | SSIM mean | SSIM min | PSNR | LPIPS |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| `LTX2Pipeline` | `TI2VidOneStagePipeline` Full/SFT | T2V | 0.999652 | 0.999564 | 58.80 dB | 0.0000367 |
| `LTX2Pipeline` | `TI2VidOneStagePipeline` Full/SFT | I2V | 0.999589 | 0.999480 | 62.37 dB | 0.0000576 |
| `LTX2TwoStagePipeline` | `TI2VidTwoStagesPipeline` Full + LoRA 450 | T2V | 0.999588 | 0.999485 | 56.40 dB | 0.0000687 |
| `LTX2TwoStagePipeline` | `TI2VidTwoStagesPipeline` Full + LoRA 450 | I2V | 0.999585 | 0.999475 | 62.10 dB | 0.0000627 |
| `LTX2DistilledTwoStagePipeline` | `DistilledPipeline` | T2V | 0.997186 | 0.996164 | 46.04 dB | 0.003450 |
| `LTX2DistilledTwoStagePipeline` | `DistilledPipeline` | I2V | 0.996489 | 0.995810 | 46.29 dB | 0.003787 |

The Full two-stage I2V diagnosis is stronger than decoded similarity: native and Omni are bitwise exact at the Stage 1 packed output, Stage 2 input, and Stage 2 final packed latent. The fixed issue was premature BF16 rounding of the official FP32 Stage 2 re-noise scalar. All public paths now pass SSIM mean/min >= 0.99 and PSNR >= 40 dB.

The native project has no public distilled one-stage entrypoint. `LTX2DistilledOneStagePipeline` remains a supported Omni mode and is covered by unit/runnable checks, but is intentionally not presented as an independent public native E2E row.

Permanent guard:

- [`test_ltx25_official_similarity.py`](https://github.com/lishunyang12/vllm-omni/blob/feat/ltx-2-5-support/tests/e2e/accuracy/ltx/test_ltx25_official_similarity.py)
- [`run_ltx25_reference.py`](https://github.com/lishunyang12/vllm-omni/blob/feat/ltx-2-5-support/tests/e2e/accuracy/ltx/run_ltx25_reference.py)

### Full/SFT one-stage

```bash
python examples/offline_inference/text_to_video/text_to_video.py \
  --model Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers --model-class-name LTX2Pipeline \
  --prompt "A cinematic red fox walking through a snowy forest at dawn, tracked alongside." \
  --height 544 --width 960 --num-frames 121 --num-inference-steps 30 \
  --frame-rate 24 --fps 24 --enforce-eager --output ltx25-full-one-stage.mp4
```

### Full/SFT two-stage

```bash
python examples/offline_inference/text_to_video/text_to_video.py \
  --model Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers --model-class-name LTX2TwoStagePipeline \
  --prompt "A cinematic red fox walking through a snowy forest at dawn, tracked alongside." \
  --height 1088 --width 1920 --num-frames 121 --num-inference-steps 30 \
  --frame-rate 24 --fps 24 --enforce-eager --output ltx25-full-two-stage.mp4
```

### Distilled one-stage

```bash
python examples/offline_inference/text_to_video/text_to_video.py \
  --model Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers --model-class-name LTX2DistilledOneStagePipeline \
  --prompt "A cinematic red fox walking through a snowy forest at dawn, tracked alongside." \
  --height 544 --width 960 --num-frames 121 --num-inference-steps 8 \
  --frame-rate 24 --fps 24 --enforce-eager --output ltx25-distilled-one-stage.mp4
```

### Distilled two-stage

```bash
python examples/offline_inference/text_to_video/text_to_video.py \
  --model Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers --model-class-name LTX2DistilledTwoStagePipeline \
  --prompt "A cinematic red fox walking through a snowy forest at dawn, tracked alongside." \
  --height 1088 --width 1920 --num-frames 121 --num-inference-steps 8 \
  --frame-rate 24 --fps 24 --enforce-eager --output ltx25-distilled-two-stage.mp4
```

For I2V, use `examples/offline_inference/image_to_video/image_to_video.py`, preserve the same class-specific dimensions and steps, and add `--image /absolute/path/to/first-frame.png`. The complete offline and online commands are in [`recipes/LTX/LTX-2.5.md`](https://github.com/lishunyang12/vllm-omni/blob/feat/ltx-2-5-support/recipes/LTX/LTX-2.5.md). Hosted long-form outputs remain in the [B300 gallery](https://lishunyang12.github.io/vllm-omni-rankings/scripts/ltx25_official_b300_1080p20s/).

comments.author: hsliuustc0106
comments.body:
## Independent LTX-2.5 parity and runnable pipeline check

Locally tested at PR head `e2721dc97d48a412128327039b2a80bb07c5b0ea` on NVIDIA L20X GPUs with Python 3.12.13, vLLM 0.27.0, vLLM-Omni `0.27.0rc2.dev60+ge2721dc97`, PyTorch 2.13.0+cu129, Diffusers 0.38.0, and PyAV 18.1.0. GPU 1/2 were isolated for the final runs and were released afterward.

### Official parity reproduction

The PR's added harness pinned native Lightricks source [`7954dcb`](https://github.com/Lightricks/LTX-2/commit/7954dcb0d986bdc36ef272564a9789ade07fcc65), raw model revision `8a4ff96f581e72bedc1b44367581c49d544a05f1`, and Diffusers/connector revision `a6de4b5354f078db24d9cf4778c14846788aea3d`. Native and Omni ran sequentially on the same local GPU with PyTorch SDPA, seed 42, 24 FPS, 25 decoded frames, identical connector inputs, and the checked-in schedules.

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=2 HF_HOME=/workspace/model python -m pytest -q -s \
  tests/e2e/accuracy/ltx/test_ltx25_official_similarity.py \
  -k 'ltx25_distilled_two_stage_matches_official or ltx25_full_matches_official'
```

All six public native comparisons completed but failed their checked-in similarity gates locally:

| vLLM-Omni pipeline | Native reference | Task | SSIM mean | SSIM min | PSNR | LPIPS | Audio rel. L2 | Audio cosine | Result |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---|
| `LTX2Pipeline` | `TI2VidOneStagePipeline` Full/SFT | T2V | 0.931155 | 0.915337 | 24.65 dB | 0.044330 | 0.55994 | 0.848014 | Failed |
| `LTX2Pipeline` | `TI2VidOneStagePipeline` Full/SFT | I2V | 0.990583 | 0.986151 | 38.09 dB | 0.005834 | 0.89176 | 0.605688 | Failed (audio) |
| `LTX2TwoStagePipeline` | `TI2VidTwoStagesPipeline` Full + LoRA 450 | T2V | 0.730983 | 0.658280 | 19.28 dB | 0.124694 | 1.18078 | 0.411082 | Failed |
| `LTX2TwoStagePipeline` | `TI2VidTwoStagesPipeline` Full + LoRA 450 | I2V | 0.954715 | 0.934198 | 28.58 dB | 0.036060 | 0.53330 | 0.856538 | Failed |
| `LTX2DistilledTwoStagePipeline` | `DistilledPipeline` | T2V | 0.662850 | 0.654343 | 17.81 dB | 0.369542 | 2.59623 | 0.140727 | Failed |
| `LTX2DistilledTwoStagePipeline` | `DistilledPipeline` | I2V | 0.926517 | 0.876693 | 27.38 dB | 0.043394 | 1.14267 | 0.418109 | Failed |

The full gates are SSIM mean/min >= 0.95/0.90, PSNR >= 30 dB, LPIPS <= 0.01 (T2V) or 0.02 (I2V), audio relative L2 <= 0.3, and cosine >= 0.95. The distilled gates are stricter: mean SSIM >= 0.995 (T2V) or 0.99 (I2V), min SSIM >= 0.99, PSNR >= 40 dB, LPIPS <= 0.01, with the same audio gates.

These L20X/cu129 results do not reproduce the [author's B300/cu130 parity matrix](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/pull/6070#issuecomment-5285202605). Hardware/software differ from that report, but each local native/Omni pair used the same device, stack, weights, seed, backend, and conditioning; the gaps are too large to classify as ordinary tolerance noise. The checked-in harness should be reconciled or the hardware-specific numerical contract documented before using it as permanent CI evidence.

Permanent paths at the tested head:

- [`test_ltx25_official_similarity.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/blob/e2721dc97d48a412128327039b2a80bb07c5b0ea/tests/e2e/accuracy/ltx/test_ltx25_official_similarity.py)
- [`run_ltx25_reference.py`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/blob/e2721dc97d48a412128327039b2a80bb07c5b0ea/tests/e2e/accuracy/ltx/run_ltx25_reference.py)

### Focused tests and runnable public examples

```bash
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' HF_HOME=/workspace/model python -m pytest -q \
  tests/diffusion/models/ltx2/test_ltx25_pipeline.py
```

Result: **36 passed in 2.70 s**.

I also ran the four documented T2V pipeline classes at their class-specific dimensions/steps and one first-frame I2V command. Each isolated command exited 0 and encoded H.264 video at 24 FPS plus 48 kHz stereo AAC:

| Public pipeline | Task | Dimensions / frames / steps | Generation | Peak reserved GPU | Encoded output |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| `LTX2Pipeline` | T2V | 960x544 / 121 / 30 | 77.00 s | 82,168 MiB | 5.042 s, 4,364,209 bytes |
| `LTX2TwoStagePipeline` | T2V | 1920x1088 / 121 / 30 | 92.24 s | 120,618 MiB | 5.042 s, 11,494,223 bytes |
| `LTX2DistilledOneStagePipeline` | T2V | 960x544 / 121 / 8 | 9.42 s | 78,666 MiB | 5.042 s, 2,940,282 bytes |
| `LTX2DistilledTwoStagePipeline` | T2V | 1920x1088 / 121 / 8 | 23.58 s | 111,716 MiB | 5.042 s, 9,125,194 bytes |
| `LTX2DistilledTwoStagePipeline` | I2V | 1920x1088 / 121 / 8 | 24.76 s | — | 5.042 s, 1,799,839 bytes |

Exact T2V commands used (substitute an available GPU):

```bash
python examples/offline_inference/text_to_video/text_to_video.py \
  --model Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers --model-class-name LTX2Pipeline \
  --prompt "A cinematic red fox walking through a snowy forest at dawn, tracked alongside." \
  --height 544 --width 960 --num-frames 121 --num-inference-steps 30 \
  --frame-rate 24 --fps 24 --enforce-eager --output ltx25-full-one-stage.mp4

python examples/offline_inference/text_to_video/text_to_video.py \
  --model Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers --model-class-name LTX2TwoStagePipeline \
  --prompt "A cinematic red fox walking through a snowy forest at dawn, tracked alongside." \
  --height 1088 --width 1920 --num-frames 121 --num-inference-steps 30 \
  --frame-rate 24 --fps 24 --enforce-eager --output ltx25-full-two-stage.mp4

python examples/offline_inference/text_to_video/text_to_video.py \
  --model Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers --model-class-name LTX2DistilledOneStagePipeline \
  --prompt "A cinematic red fox walking through a snowy forest at dawn, tracked alongside." \
  --height 544 --width 960 --num-frames 121 --num-inference-steps 8 \
  --frame-rate 24 --fps 24 --enforce-eager --output ltx25-distilled-one-stage.mp4

python examples/offline_inference/text_to_video/text_to_video.py \
  --model Lightricks/LTX-2.5-Diffusers --model-class-name LTX2DistilledTwoStagePipeline \
  --prompt "A cinematic red fox walking through a snowy forest at dawn, tracked alongside." \
  --height 1088 --width 1920 --num-frames 121 --num-inference-steps 8 \
  --frame-rate 24 --fps 24 --enforce-eager --output ltx25-distilled-two-stage.mp4
```

For I2V I used `examples/offline_inference/image_to_video/image_to_video.py` with the same class-specific dimensions/steps and `--image /absolute/path/to/first-frame.png`. The full command set is in [`recipes/LTX/LTX-2.5.md`](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni/blob/e2721dc97d48a412128327039b2a80bb07c5b0ea/recipes/LTX/LTX-2.5.md).

Bottom line: the public pipelines are runnable locally on L20X and produce valid AV files, while the official-reference numerical parity claimed by the new E2E harness is not reproduced in this environment.

reviews.author: linyueqian
reviews.body: Reviewed at 98af1ec73. The 2.5-specific work (CRF-18 I2V, unpacked FP32 latent RNG, dynamic sigma shift, version detection, profiles/recipes) looks well built and well tested. My comments are all about side effects on the released LTX-2/2.3 paths that share this code. Separately: the intel-ci failure is pre-existing on main HEAD, not from this PR.
